questions.question: A New Testament letter says believers are surrounded by a great cloud of witnesses. What does the writer tell them to do?

answers.text: Run with endurance the race set out for them
Sit back and watch the faithful go first
Build a monument to remember the faithful

questions.question: According to the Bible, why did Jesus endure the cross?

answers.text: For the joy set before Him
To prove His strength to sinners
To win the praise of the crowd
